g.text: Baseline is a site-wise unphased BAF statistic,

text.style: fill: #d55e00; font: 700 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif
fill: #1a1a1a; font: 8.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Detection power against cell fraction, at a fixed false-positive rate

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #d55e00; stroke-width: 1.3; stroke-linecap: square

text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #009e73; stroke-width: 1.3; stroke-linecap: square

text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

path.style: fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 4.81,2.08; stroke-dashoffset: 0; stroke: #009e73; stroke-width: 1.3

text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Simulation, no patient data. Seed 42 (preregistered) · 200 replicates per cell · depth 44× · 400 heterozygous sites per chromosome · 3 affected chromosomes · panels A–C at 20 % cell fraction, 1 200 sites each.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Variegated power of this site-wise ABSOLUTE statistic falls from 0.055 to 0.000. The project first attributed that to lineage cancellation and its own audit falsified it: an absolute statistic is blind to sign.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: The 2x2 ablation (EXP-015c, POST-HOC, designed after the audit and not preregistered) shows the fall is driven by copy-number-dependent depth. What cancellation does move is the SIGNED statistic, 0.980 to 0.050.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: No superiority over the standard method is claimed: the comparator is unphased and MoChA is not reproduced here.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Simulated power is optimistic: no GC bias, no mappability, no reference-allele bias, which at this depth are the real limiting factors.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: end

g.text: Figure class: simulation Evidence origin: simulated
